finding.initial_finding: DSMZ885 establishes PHC polymer and Toagosei/Mn2000 context, but the source CAS61630-98-6 requires a bounded first-applicable identifier check. Independent supplier primary identifies this CAS with hydroxyl-terminated PHC diol. Whether that narrower scope applies to the original polymer must be explicitly adjudicated; failed Sigma retrieval is not a sufficient generic-grade rationale.
finding.disposition: Resolved on exact successor: personally inspected government inventory entry11389 (polycarbonate diol, carbonate polymer of1,6-hexanediol, CAS61630-98-6), the supplier PHC-diol declaration and original DSMZ885/ingredient812 source CAS. These corroborate the registry at polymer scope; no fixed chain length, end-group structure, grade equality or emulsion identity is imported. Exact C v2 payload uses CAS primary and broader CHEBI61433.

finding.initial_finding: Independent primary AmericanElements datasheet explicitly establishes MgSO4·6H2O/CAS17830-18-1. This is a concrete first-applicable CAS lead requiring successor curation of the existing local owner; no-change based on absence of an ontology term is insufficient until this evidence is adjudicated.
finding.disposition: Resolved with new exact successor: personally checked EPA2020-14401 listing magnesium sulfate hexahydrate CAS17830-18-1 separately from adjacent hydrates, plus AmericanElements explicit MgSO4·6H2O datasheet. The final proposal promotes the existing local primary to that CAS, retains broader CHEBI32599, original six-water formula and rejected sibling-hydrate labels, and imports neither anhydrous structure nor supplier melting point.
